description: XML-RPC replies from XMLRPC::Lite 0.717 (SOAP::Lite 1.27) under its HTTP daemon, serving the gateway's five methods over data.json.
substitutions: The gateway's service page says XMLRPC::Lite took over the endpoint from Frontier::RPC. This is XMLRPC::Lite 0.717, the release split out of SOAP::Lite, as Debian 12 packages it, under its own HTTP daemon (XMLRPC::Transport::HTTP::Daemon on HTTP::Daemon) instead of Apache.
The handlers are this set's lite.pl, written for the recording; the serializer, the dispatcher, the content-type check and the HTTP server are the modules'.
client: scripts/record.mjs: a raw TCP socket from the host to the published port; each request is written as listed, with Content-Length and Connection: close added.
commands: docker exec hostile-recording-xmlrpc-lite perl -e print qq{$^V\n}

docker exec hostile-recording-xmlrpc-lite perl -MXMLRPC::Lite -MSOAP::Lite -MHTTP::Daemon -e print qq{XMLRPC::Lite $XMLRPC::Lite::VERSION
SOAP::Lite $SOAP::Lite::VERSION
HTTP::Daemon $HTTP::Daemon::VERSION
}
docker exec hostile-recording-xmlrpc-lite dpkg-query --show libxmlrpc-lite-perl libsoap-lite-perl libhttp-daemon-perl libxml-parser-perl perl

exchanges.name: account-title
exchanges.description: account.title("00012345"): a title with letters outside ASCII, returned as a typed string.

exchanges.name: invoice-get
exchanges.description: invoice.get(7): a struct of an integer, an all-digit string, a double, a boolean, two dates and an array of structs whose text needs escaping.

exchanges.name: invoice-unpaid
exchanges.description: invoice.get(8): false, the zero date, a migrated impossible date and an empty array.

exchanges.name: extract-fetch
exchanges.description: extract.fetch("202610"): 320 bytes of ISO-8859-1 as a typed base64 value.

exchanges.name: fault-not-found
exchanges.description: invoice.get(999): the handler dies with a SOAP::Fault carrying the gateway's 404.

exchanges.name: fault-malformed
exchanges.description: A call that is not well-formed XML: a bare ampersand.

exchanges.name: not-xml
exchanges.description: A well-formed call sent as text/plain.
